title: ResearchAppendix
description: Artifact produced by phase-4b-research (TASK-0075). Contains resolved information for all uncertainty markers and new external dependencies flagged in the feature-planning output. Injected as context into all phase-4a reviewer skills.

marker_text.description: The exact marker found: TBD, UNVERIFIED, ASSUMPTION, UNCLEAR, or NEEDS_RESEARCH.

field_path.description: JSONPath to the field containing the marker, e.g., 'tasks[3].description'.

uncertainty_resolutions.description: One resolution entry per unique uncertainty marker in the plan.

summary.description: Human-readable executive summary of research findings. Injected verbatim into reviewer context.

source.description: Package registry, git URL, or vendor name.

resolution_status.description: resolved: clear answer found. partially_resolved: best available answer but uncertainty remains. unresolvable: no information available — reviewer must treat as high-risk assumption.

resolved_value.description: The resolved content. For unresolvable markers, states the specific gap and recommended risk mitigation.

confidence.description: Confidence in the resolved value. Injected as context to reviewers.

sources.description: References (doc URLs, RFC numbers, library version pages) supporting the resolution.

license.description: SPDX license identifier, e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0.

security_status.description: clean: no known CVEs. known_cves: CVEs exist (listed in cve_refs). unmaintained: no activity in >18 months. unknown: could not assess.

recommendation.description: approved: safe to use. approved_with_conditions: usable but conditions noted. rejected: do not use — provide alternative.

conditions_or_alternative.description: Required when recommendation != approved. States conditions or alternative package.
